description: Assemble a read-only, retrieval/provenance-first grounding briefing for an agent: named bundles (process catalog, plan state, guidance, frame, conversation), the answer contract, available process contracts, and per-block provenance. Never calls an inference provider — no local model required. Use to get grounding before acting without asking the solet to reason for you.
embedding_description: Assemble a structured, provenance-tagged context briefing for a coding agent — process catalog, plan state, guidance, and answer contract as data — without running any language model.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Briefing with keys: profile (assembly profile name), bundles (named bundles: process_catalog, plan_state, guidance, frame, conversation, answer_contract, other; each a list of {content, source_kind, subtype, reasoning_slot, provenance}), answer_contract (decode/answer schema as data, or null), available_contracts (list of process_key strings), provenance (flat rows of {block_id, source_kind, kind, ref}), manifest (block_count, bundle_counts, budget, budget_applied, dropped, has_answer_contract)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use the bundles and answer_contract as grounding to determine and construct the next action; do not treat the briefing itself as a completed task.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Assembles a structured grounding briefing (context bundles + provenance + answer contract) from the prompt-assembly pipeline without invoking any inference provider
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: FrameworkError 'prompts_dir not found' or missing memory/discovery service: a platform service the assembly pipeline depends on is not available. ValueError: a malformed playbook or guidance section was encountered during assembly.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For missing-service errors: the platform may still be starting up — suggest waiting for readiness and retrying. For malformed-artifact errors: report the specific playbook/section so it can be corrected; the briefing does not fall back to inference.
